results.rationale: Consistency: white background and silver fork design persist, but original forks are resized and spacing changes substantially beyond count removal. Instruction: eight forks become nine, with four above and five below, instead of six; opposite count change. Quality: coherent separate fork silhouettes, four tines each and smooth metallic surfaces; no noticeable artifacts.

Instruction: thin book remains very thin while the thick book grows; expected right-book thickness match is absent. Quality: recognizable books and page textures; slight warped overhang on the large book top cover is a minor defect.
